description: Expected output of `failfirst describe --json`; every implementation must match it exactly.

anthropic.name: failfirst_baseline
anthropic.description: Run the acceptance criteria on the UNFIXED state and write the lockfile (.failfirst.lock.json). Call once, before any work. Returns a baseline report; exit_code 0 means every machine criterion failed as required. Refuses to overwrite an existing lockfile (FF_E_LOCK_EXISTS).

criteria.description: Path to the criteria file (.json/.yaml). Default: failfirst.yaml, failfirst.yml, failfirst.json, criteria.yaml, criteria.yml or criteria.json in the working directory.

lock.description: Lockfile path. Default: .failfirst.lock.json next to the criteria file.

dry_run.description: Run the criteria and report, but write no lockfile and no report file.

force.description: Overwrite an existing lockfile. Destroys the failure evidence; only a human owner should set this.

anthropic.name: failfirst_verify
anthropic.description: Re-run the criteria AFTER the work and check each was proven: failed at baseline, unchanged since, and passes now. Returns a verify report; status is pass, fail or awaiting_review. Needs a lockfile from failfirst_baseline (FF_E_NO_LOCK otherwise).

criteria.description: Path to the criteria file (.json/.yaml). Default: failfirst.yaml, failfirst.yml, failfirst.json, criteria.yaml, criteria.yml or criteria.json in the working directory.

lock.description: Lockfile path. Default: .failfirst.lock.json next to the criteria file.
